'''Horizon Development''' builds custom software and web applications, from concept to deployment, using modern technologies. It is a subsidiary of [[Horizon Network]].<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/companies Our companies], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>

== Services ==
* '''Web applications'''
* '''Custom software'''
* '''From concept to deployment''' — taking a project from first idea to launch

Horizon Development turns ideas into useful software. As a Horizon Network company, its work can sit on the network's digital infrastructure and be promoted through [[Horizon Advertising]].<ref>[https://network.hngroup.org.uk/services Our services], horizon-network.co.uk.</ref> Enquiries about projects are handled through the Horizon Network and HN Group contact forms.

== Structure ==
Horizon Development is a wholly owned subsidiary of [[Horizon Network]].

{{Company ownership|Horizon Development}}

== Brand ==
[[File:horizon-development-roundel.svg|thumb|The Horizon Development roundel]]
Horizon Development's logo is a thick indigo ring containing the initials '''HD''', alongside the company name. The roundel is also used on its own and as an app icon.
